name: X-Stage Song Studio PC Ready
notes: Verified Windows 10/11 x64 portable ZIP. NCN intro/outro analysis now scans ONLY .LYR files under Lyrics (including subfolders), without reading MIDI or CUR. It reports total LYR count and progress. Standalone Lyrics folders are analysis-only. On confirmed replacements, only selected records get full MID/LYR/CUR validity checks and safe paired LYR/CUR backups/undo; MIDI files remain unchanged. Existing StageWeb/LRC workflows and customizable X-Stage Karaoke replacements remain supported. Extract the ZIP and run Start-Song-Studio.cmd.
